sections.section_title: RCC I/O port clock enable register (RCC_IOPENR)
sections.text_helper: Section 6.4.12 "RCC I/O port clock enable register (RCC_IOPENR)" in chapter 6 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 147.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x34
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:6 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 5 GPIOFEN: I/O port F clock enable
This bit is set and cleared by software.
0: Disable
1: Enable
Bit 4 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 3 GPIODEN: I/O port D clock enable
This bit is set and cleared by software.
0: Disable
1: Enable
Bit 2 GPIOCEN: I/O port C clock enable
This bit is set and cleared by software.
0: Disable
1: Enable
Bit 1 GPIOBEN: I/O port B clock enable
This bit is set and cleared by software.
0: Disable
1: Enable
Bit 0 GPIOAEN: I/O port A clock enable
This bit is set and cleared by software.
0: Disable
1: Enable
